title: ThreatLens — SOC Investigation & Threat Intelligence Platform
desc: A self-hosted SOC platform that orchestrates concurrent threat intelligence feeds, correlates multi-stage attack telemetry, and surfaces actionable incident verdicts on an interactive dashboard.
capabilities: Multi-pipeline signal collection running parallel queries against 70+ VirusTotal engines and Google Safe Browsing APIs.
Multi-source risk aggregation engine applying dynamic weights to telemetry without external dependencies.
Attack path reconstruction mapping alerts directly across MITRE ATT&CK techniques and Cyber Kill Chain phases.
Real-time event streaming and interactive triage via WebSocket/SocketIO pipelines.

title: MCP-Guardian — Model Context Protocol Security Firewall
desc: A real-time security firewall protecting autonomous AI agents against prompt injection, tool poisoning, and data leakage across Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystems.
capabilities: Sandboxed tool execution intercepting JSON-RPC protocol calls before underlying system command execution.
Multi-tool attack chain detection preventing cascading privilege escalation across connected agent tools.
Strict role-based execution boundaries restricting sensitive file, network, and database tool capabilities.
Real-time PII redaction and payload quarantine sanitizing tool responses before returning to the model.

title: CyberTwin — Enterprise Attack Surface & Blast Radius Engine
desc: An AI-powered Cyber Digital Twin platform for modeling enterprise attack surfaces, calculating probabilistic breach traversal paths, and simulating lateral movement blast radius.
capabilities: Graph-based dependency modeling utilizing Neo4j to map network nodes, services, and identity relations.
Algorithmic attack path calculation identifying the shortest traversable paths to high-value assets.
Blast radius simulation evaluating the exact lateral movement potential from a single compromised endpoint.
Continuous vulnerability intelligence ingestion prioritizing CVE exposure remediation based on reachability.

title: PromptShield — Defensive LLM Security Gateway
desc: An inline defensive proxy that intercepts prompts and model completions to protect Large Language Models against prompt injection, unauthorized tool execution, and sensitive data leakage.
capabilities: Two-pass security inspection scanning inputs before reaching the model and sanitizing outputs before return.
Multi-tier detection engine combining Scikit-learn heuristic scoring with a Gemini LLM-as-judge second opinion.
Direct policy enforcement mapping threats against OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Applications.
Enterprise gateway features including token-bucket rate limiting, API-key authentication, and cryptographic audit logs.

title: PhishGuard — Machine Learning Phishing URL Detection Engine
desc: A machine learning threat engine that detects malicious phishing URLs in real time by analyzing 22 lexical and structural syntax patterns with zero external network reconnaissance.
capabilities: Trained Random Forest classifier evaluated across 120,000 verified malicious and benign URL samples.
Pure client/lexical feature extraction (zero network requests required, preventing attacker telemetry triggering).
Brand impersonation heuristics and spoof-safe domain distance matching.
Multi-level risk verdict output with complete feature importance transparency and anomaly breakdown.
